name: Shelter, Housing, Animal Enclosures & Settlement Infrastructure Runtime
design_rules: shelter capacity constrains occupancy rather than allowing infinite residents
weather protection and insulation reduce climate stress but do not eliminate it
hygiene declines with occupancy and waste unless maintained
animal enclosure security reduces escape and predator risk
storage capacity protects supplies from weather and exposure
materials influence durability insulation and water resistance
settlement infrastructure degrades and requires maintenance over time
settlement infrastructure persists across world days
settlement infrastructure never uses emissive or glow feedback
